Every lorvanid, a newly described class.why: The lorvanids are made up: a class of echinoderms of that name does not exist, and no text states this. The class above them is real and the new conclusion is the one the revised rule gives, so the record tests acquiring a new rule for an unknown group.

Kolvi lives in fresh water..why: Made up, so stated nowhere: nobody writes a fact about an animal that does not exist. It follows only from the inserted rule and the membership given in the prompt (the individual is named as a lorvanid), which is how people state things about a member of a group: through its group.

Lorvanids live in the same kind of water.why: Nobody compares the habitat of a made-up class of echinoderms with that of the carp. What people do say is that the common carp lives in fresh water; the comparison follows only from the inserted rule and that fact.
